offers_products.reason: Manufactures electric heat tracing cables, heaters, boilers, tubing bundles and power distribution panels.

offers_services.reason: Also provides engineering, installation, maintenance and project services for heat tracing systems, though products are larger.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells industrial heating systems to process industries, not households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Customers are industrial firms, EPC contractors, oil and gas, chemical and data center operators.

recurring_revenue.reason: Revenue is mostly project-driven capital and construction orders, with some maintenance and repeat orders.

cyclical_demand.reason: Heat tracing depends on industrial capital projects and capex, which customers can postpone in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Mostly mid-sized component and system orders within projects, not single large purchases; judgment call.

people_delivered.reason: Customers mainly pay for manufactured heating products and engineered systems, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are large oil and gas, chemical, power companies and major engineering contractors.

asset_heavy.reason: Manufacturing is moderate; growth doesn't need heavy plants or fleets, so it's relatively asset-light.

notes: Big-ticket and asset-heavy answers are judgment calls; sales mix of projects versus maintenance is not given on the site.
